# The predefined charsets of TN #5176, The Compact Font Format Specification,
# Appendix C, transcribed from Adobe's own PDF:
#
#   https://adobe-type-tools.github.io/font-tech-notes/pdfs/5176.CFF.pdf
#   sha256 60e0696c4fac326de597722af37bcdbbd688e0337a548709a287405ff3b3996a
#
# One entry per line, "<charset> <SID> <name>", in GID order beginning at GID 1.
# GID 0 is .notdef in every charset and the specification does not list it, so it
# is not here either.
#
# ISOAdobe is here as the control. It is the identity — SID n for GID n — which
# is knowable without reading the table at all, so a transcription that got it
# wrong would be caught by a fact the file does not carry. It caught one: the
# first extraction of this data read the PDF's three columns row-wise instead of
# column-wise, and ISOAdobe came back as 1, 21, 41, 2, 22, 42 rather than 1, 2, 3.
